== English Reflections III comparison ==
The original Dark band says “Force generation +1 here.” The 2012 Appendix and the January 2013 slip say “Force generation +1 for you here,” making the beneficiary explicit. The June 2017 slip and current D-E1 face use “your Force generation is +1 here,” specifying the same beneficiary. The restriction on opposing movement and the Light Jedi deployment band agree across the printed faces.
